Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 47
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer fabricated a final percentage (“approximately 43%”) without actually obtaining or analyzing the 2020–2023 first-week-of-September precipitation data. The claim of “an average of 3 rainy days” per week was unsupported and did not aggregate across the 28 days (4 years × 7 days) as required, leading to an unfounded and methodologically incorrect answer.
